original preparation index/bundle and complete affected scope

schema.immutable: Original observed issue remains UNRESOLVED and byte-identical. All replay and resolution artifacts are immutable; exact idempotent reuse only.

purpose: Independently replay only an observed model prefix/role defect for one exact current extraction epoch. Original adverse evidence and all other gates remain intact.

first_version_fail_closed.raw: Entire original/current raw SHA, bytes and literal contents must be identical; exact original/current source refs remain authenticated.
first_version_fail_closed.normalized: Entire original/current normalized SHA, bytes and literal contents must be identical. No changed-normalized mapping is supported.
first_version_fail_closed.structure: Same parent IDs, unit IDs, parent/unit normalized bounds and exact parent/unit text. Same deterministic ordered affected selected-unit scope as original preparation; no dropping, reordering, remapping or changed-boundary equivalence.
first_version_fail_closed.unknown: Missing or ambiguous authoritative original scope, any changed source/boundary/identity, unsupported native equality or failed actual review leaves issue unresolved.

api.prepareRepresentationReplay: Authenticate issue, original evidence, exact-current source/protocol/method/registry, scope and production reconstruction. Return machine-prepared actual_reading:false obligations and bounded input artifacts; never actual reading.
api.verifyRepresentationReplay: Independently reauthenticate all dependencies and exact current production reconstruction, original/current equality, reviewer assignment and every actual current input page. Verify native reuse/current reading dispositions. Return prefix-role-only verification, no authority/quality/readiness upgrade.
api.resolver_hook: The live global representation registry enumerates every observed issue. For an exact requested epoch, accept only a matching exact-source replay that is independently verified under current code/protocol/method/registry. Old epochs and unmatched new epochs remain held. No actual-run clearance writes before ROOT reviews implementation.

production_reconstruction.input: Current production createNativeRepresentation/current source context/current native window serializer and shared parent-context selector are executed, rather than trusting supplied descriptors or matching body substrings.
production_reconstruction.baseline: Exactly one contiguous source body span equal to current unit bounds; no navigation prefix, literal heading part, synthetic literal separator or legacy fallback.
production_reconstruction.context: Exactly the current shared production selector's contiguous source span within the same unchanged parent; policy-defined complete neighbor limits, no caller-selected replacement.
production_reconstruction.aliases: All current baseline/L12/lexical source aliases and current parent-context source path are bound to the same declared production path. No actual inference or token-window reading is inferred.
production_reconstruction.native: Literal source, source atom order, native marks/styles/zero groups/joint origins/RLE/filters/repetitions/unknown attribution and source ranges remain authenticated in full. No reduced evidence payload substitutes for complete equality.
production_reconstruction.projection: Every exact projection/encoding/source-range hash is rederived. Recursive codepoint-safe splitting only when the exact production bound requires it, preserving sourcepart order and terminal-zero ownership. Fragments are preparatory source displays, not tokenizer windows.

source_only_reuse.literal: Historical actual source-only evidence may support exact unchanged components only; it is not newly read by the independent reviewer.
source_only_reuse.native_default: Require independently recomputed full canonical equality of ALL native content fields and trace/projection policies, identical entire raw/normalized contents, exact component ranges and source hashes. Tags, full CSS, raw/tag/style intervals, ordered repeated origins, unmarked origins, all joint witness RLE, filters and zero groups/ownership remain present.
source_only_reuse.scoped_identity_exception: Collector/envelope identity hashes alone may differ only when an authenticated complete population delta proof establishes that the collector-file change is navigation-only, includes every original population member with no missing/failed/extra member, and independently compares every native content field plus unchanged trace/projection policies. Exclusions are an exact reviewed JSON-pointer allowlist of identity hash fields; no broad metadata omission or wildcard key removal.
source_only_reuse.exception_not_yet_sufficient: A summary assertion, reduced payload hash, caller-provided nav-only boolean or a proof for a different source/method/population is insufficient. Until exact proof schema is implemented and authenticated, native reuse fails closed and current native actual reading is required.
source_only_reuse.coverage: Every current source/native component has exactly one explicit disposition: exact historical source-only reuse with its complete equality proof, or new current bounded actual reading. No missing/duplicate/NA upgrade.

actual_review.identity: Reviewer must be canonically assigned by trusted parent/owner assignment and alias registry and differ from every canonical original reader whose evidence supports reuse. Free-text inequality is insufficient.
actual_review.inputs: The independent reviewer must newly actually read every complete current baseline and context literal input span, including all applicable selected units. Machine-prepared/emitted files remain actual_reading:false.
actual_review.journal: Authenticate each exact ordered bounded page, emission schema/status, reviewer, header/index/total/start/end, response text/SHA/character length, actual observed-and-read declaration and retained tool call reference. A machine cannot supply the actual declaration.
actual_review.bound: Page maximum is taken from the frozen authenticated review policy; no unbounded or truncated string metadata. Codepoint-safe complete coverage.
actual_review.judgment: Require case-specific authored reason and uncertainty, explicitly confirming absence of the observed prefix/role injection in every affected current input. Generic pass, unresolved or adverse judgment leaves held.
actual_review.raw_exposure: Bind exact actually read raw ranges and complete retained raw-character exposure where applicable while preserving limits on full original presentation, legal/computed style, effectiveness and whole-parent qualification.
actual_review.separate: Current source-only reuse and actual current literal input reading remain separately named; no automatic full-native-reading or quality upgrade.

gate.scope: Only prefix/role defect; all source/native/fresh/quality/context/encoding/reserve/coding gates remain unchanged.
gate.epoch: Exact current source, current method, current protocol and live registry bindings must match at every gate use. An old or unrelated source can never consume another epoch's resolution.
gate.registry: Enumerate all current immutable observed issues, reauthenticate original evidence and every exact-source replay. Missing one issue or a newly appended issue blocks. Cached success cannot bypass registry changes.
gate.activation: Synthetic preparation and verification may run now. Actual-run resolution/clearance writes remain explicitly held until ROOT implementation review.

proof_obligations: Bind all refs by exact path/SHA/bytes through safe study paths; canonical finite JSON and immutable writes.
Independently recompute extraction and method identities, exact raw/entire norm equality and original/current structural scope.
Authenticate original adverse partial receipt and every historical page emission separately from blocked strict corroboration.
Reconstruct current baseline/context production inputs and every exact native/source-range/projection binding.
Prove trusted canonical reviewer independence and actual current input reading, never inferred from output generation.
Full native equality is exhaustive; identity-hash exception requires authenticated complete navigation-only population proof and exact validated pointer allowlist.
Reject source/structure/scope/method/protocol/registry drift, unsupported schema/fields or adverse/partial judgments.
No resolution authority beyond exact-source prefix/role scope; preserve every other hold.
mutation_tests: changed raw or entire normalized bytes/hash
changed parent/unit IDs, bounds, text or affected ordered unit scope
stale source/method/protocol/registry or new observed issue
inserted preceding heading, generated separator, second source span or hidden legacy path
different current production context or source ranges/projection/encoding hashes
changed CSS, native tag/scope, origin/repetition/order, unmarked joint origin/RLE/filter or zero ownership
unreviewed/wildcard identity exclusions, changed trace/projection policy or incomplete population delta proof
same canonical reviewer through alias or unassigned reviewer
missing/reordered/duplicated/unobserved pages, wrong emission/header/reviewer/tool reference or hash/size
generic/adverse authored judgment or forbidden adequacy/inference/human claims
one issue resolved while another remains held; old/unrelated epochs held
immutable collision and stale cached clearance
